paper: Longstaff and Schwartz (2001), Table 1, American put experiment

estimator.sampling: paired Z and -Z shocks; standard errors use antithetic pair averages
estimator.regressors: constant plus weighted Laguerre L0, L1, and L2 of spot/strike
estimator.valuation: in-sample stopping-policy fit and valuation, as in Table 1

reference: 2000-step Bermudan CRR tree aligned to the 50-per-year exercise grid; not the paper's finite-difference reference
notes: Each maturity uses 50 exercise dates per year (50 or 100 total dates).
Antithetic pair averages are the independent observations for standard errors.
In-sample standard errors do not measure independent policy-evaluation uncertainty.
In-sample estimates reproduce the paper protocol, not the independent-evaluation baseline.
The paper's 100,000-path Table 1 uses 50,000 antithetic pairs.
